title: OGM2000 asset metadata card
description: One card per logical asset or per collection. Research draft for C3 (docs/research/v0.5/C3-asset-metadata-standard.md). Vocabularies are enums under $defs/vocab. To propose a new tag, a tagger puts it in `proposed_tags` instead of the field; curation (gm-pack-curate) accepts it by adding it to the enum here, bumping the minor schema version and `vocab`, and running the migration that moves accepted tags into place. Rules that need more than one card (rights intersection, inheritance, rig sharing) are checked by code, not by this schema; see C3 section 'Checks code runs'.

vocab.description: Date stamp of the vocabulary release the tags were checked against.

collection.description: Asset cards: the collection this asset belongs to. Fields left out inherit from it (see C3 'Inheritance').

generation.description: How the asset content was generated. Collection values are inherited by member assets.

allOf.description: Once a card is tagged or reviewed, the descriptive core must be filled.
Per-kind measured blocks are required once measured.
Quarantined cards always carry the strict default rights.
Vendor-store previews require explicit vendor-metadata provenance.

assetId.description: B11 id: <tier>:<collection>/<path>@<version>. Path is lowercase kebab, no file extension, no vendor format folder ("GLB format").

spdxExpression.description: SPDX license expression. Vendor licenses use LicenseRef-<vendor>-<name>, e.g. LicenseRef-synty-personal. NOASSERTION = not known yet (card must then be quarantined).

bucketKey.description: Relative key in the private asset library or instance bucket. Traversal segments, absolute paths, and URLs with credentials are forbidden.

assetPath.description: Relative path inside the collection; traversal and backslashes are forbidden.

status.description: quarantined: license unknown, strict rights, invisible to game search. draft: identified, filename tags only. measured: code facts filled. tagged: model fields filled and validated. reviewed: a human checked it. rejected: kept for hash matching only.

use.description: Allowed uses (C2 §10 Usage rights). vision-input covers any model analysis of the file, vision or audio. edit-audio: cut, loop, fade, stretch or transpose whole tracks for a game. derive-audio: stems, motifs, MIDI, re-arranging, or AI conditioning on the audio.

styleFamily.description: C2 §2 starter families, plus photoreal (ambientCG/Poly Haven textures; not a creation choice yet) and any (style-neutral: most audio, UI sounds, particle masks, fonts).

mapFeature.description: The map-layout-spec feature types plus the drawn structures a builder asks for by name (road, bridge, stairs, door).

role.description: What the asset is for in a game. Called `roles` (not `uses`) so it never collides with rights.uses.

gameFit.description: Game situations a music track is scored against in describe.game_fit.

provenanceBy.description: code: measured from the file. model: vision/LLM tagger. human: curation edit (always locked). filename: parsed from names/folders. vendor-metadata: e.g. Synty MaterialList, Kenney Tilesheet.txt. collection: inherited. license: from license text. default: strict default.

rights.description: Effective usage rights. Written only by intake code (from license text, after the admin confirms) and by the admin. Never by a model. Code recomputes the effective values from `basis` and refuses a card where they disagree. On an asset card, `rights` may be omitted to inherit the collection's.

attribution.description: Required credit text, or null when none is required.

processing.description: Where model processing of the bytes may happen. local-only is the default for every LicenseRef-* licence and every quarantined collection: the bytes never leave this machine.

rightsBasis.description: One source of a rule. Ceiling = the confirmed `license` entry (or the `default` entry when no license is confirmed), plus the uses of any admin `interpretation` entries. Effective rights = the ceiling intersected with every `decision` entry. A decision can only remove uses, keep audience at or below, and keep redistribution at or below; it can never widen. An interpretation records the admin's reading of terms the license does not address: it may add uses only (its audience and redistribution are ignored), never a use the license `forbids`, and it is replaced when the licensor answers.

forbids.description: license entries: uses the license text explicitly forbids. No interpretation may add them.

ref.description: Where the rule came from: a license file path inside the collection, a license URL, or a decision note. Never a download link, key or serial.

confirmed_by.description: license entries: the admin who confirmed intake's reading. Unconfirmed license entries do not count.

path.description: Path inside the collection's extracted folder.

content_hash.description: Hash of the primary original file. Cache key for tagging is (content_hash, schema major, vocab, tagger version).

previews.description: Relative private asset-library or instance-bucket keys. Previews inherit the asset's rights: a redistribution:none asset's previews are private too and are hash-blocked from game repos.

describe.description: Judgment fields. Written by the model (or parsed from filenames at draft), validated by code, editable by humans.

objects.description: Open vocabulary: lowercase singular English nouns, normalized by code (lemma + synonym map) to canonical forms. Not an enum.

set.description: Measured visual-compatibility group nested under style_family.

world.description: Curated world grouping within a compatibility set.

keywords.description: Free search words that fit no other field (e.g. colour names, vendor naming). Not faceted.

game_fit.description: Music: the situations the track suits (at most two, possibly none), each with a 0-1 strength. Absent situations are not suitable or not judged.

look.description: Measured by code from the preview render or image.

geometry.description: 3D facts, measured by code after B11 normalization (1 unit = 1 m, Y-up, origin at base).

texture_keys.description: Textures used, by path within the collection; a shared atlas shows up as the same entry on many cards.

texture_sizes.description: Measured pixel size of each texture the model references, read from the image headers. `key` is the texture path for an external image and the image name for one embedded in a GLB.

max_texture_px.description: Largest texture dimension on this model: the number a device-tier texture cap is compared against.

normalized.description: False until B11 normalization ran; bounds are then in source units.

rig_id.description: Hash of the sorted joint names plus parent links. Same rig_id = animations transfer. 'Shares a rig with' is an index query on this field, not stored on the card.

retarget_rig_id.description: A different rig whose clips play on this skeleton: every joint here exists there with the same parent; tracks for that rig's extra joints are dropped. Set when no clip library targets rig_id itself.

canonical.description: Mapped by code from the name (synonym table), so agents can ask for 'die' whatever the vendor calls it.

anim.description: Stand-alone animation files (e.g. Synty ANIMATION packs).

open_edges.description: Edges a neighbour piece can attach to.

image.description: Shared 2D facts for sprites, textures, VFX, UI and inspiration maps. Measured by code.

indexed_colors.description: Palette size for indexed PNGs, else null.

directions.description: Facing set of a directional sprite in sheet-row or per-direction-file order; its length is the facing count.

sheet_index.description: Position in the collection's packed tilesheet, when one exists.

nine_slice.description: UI panels: left, top, right, bottom insets in px.

tileable.description: Code test: seam difference when wrapped below a threshold.

audio.description: Measured by code only: ffmpeg (ebur128, aspectralstats), key/rhythm/loudness detectors, beat tracking and a loop detector. Model judgments about music live in describe.*.

loudness_lufs.description: Integrated EBU R128. null for clips under 0.4 s, where the gate gives no reading; use peak_dbfs.

loopable.description: Code test: seam click and level match between end and start. null = not tested.

key_strength.description: Key detector confidence; below about 0.5 treat the key as unreliable.

tempo_alternatives.description: Half/double readings of tempo_bpm, kept because beat trackers often pick the wrong octave.

meter.description: Beats per bar from downbeat tracking (3 = waltz time, 4 = common time).

energy.description: Overall energy from loudness and onset density, normalised across the library.

cuts.description: Other files that are cuts of the same piece (a 30 s edit, a loop, a stinger). Also listed in source.files with role companion. Not `variants`, which means device tiers.

offset_s.description: Where the cut starts inside the primary file, when found by fingerprint.

search_notes.description: One line of what an agent would search for: the track or sound in words, its kind, and the facts that narrow it (mood, genre, duration, material). Written by code from the same fields the card validates, so the search result row can be judged without opening the file.

analysis.description: Path of the analysis sidecar (beats, downbeats, loudness and energy curves, sections, raw model output), relative to the collection folder.

vendor.description: Tags the vendor embedded in the file (ID3, RIFF INFO, DAW labels), copied by code. tempo_bpm is the composer's project tempo; it settles half/double ties in the measured tempo_bpm.

ucs_cat_id.description: Optional Universal Category System CatID (e.g. DOORWood), read from a UCS filename and otherwise model-proposed, for SFX.

variation_group.description: The set a sound effect belongs to: its folder and name with the trailing variation number removed (weapons/sword-slice for Sword_Slice_01 and _02). Shared by every file of the set, so 'give me four sword impacts' is one group query. A file with no sibling carries no group.

pixel_font_px.description: Native size for bitmap-style fonts, else null.

tintable.description: Greyscale art meant to be coloured at runtime.

emitter_preset.description: Key of an SDK particle preset that uses this texture, if one exists. Engine-specific emitters (Unity prefabs) are not imported.

map.description: Inspiration maps (C2 §9). Never shipped; rights decide what agents may do with them.

is_map.description: False for standees, token sheets, symbol sheets, handouts, textures and papercraft shipped beside the maps.

usable.description: Whether an agent should build from it: reference-only for zoomed-out maps nobody walks on.

view.description: How the place is drawn: top-down plan, side view or cross-section, or a perspective panorama.

publication.description: Product or issue title the map came from.

site.description: Groups floorplans of the same place across images (e.g. one castle, several floors).

layout.description: C3 §12 layout facts, so a map is chosen by structure and not by text: the graph counts come from a validated layout spec (code recomputes them) and grid, biome, features and levels from code measurements on the export. An absent field is unknown, never zero.

rooms.description: Rooms in the layout spec; code counts them from the graph.

loops.description: Independent cycles: connections - rooms + components, with outside counted as a node.

levels.description: Floors of this place the image shows, from the export title and its level links.

size_class.description: Specs by room count: small <= 5, medium 6-15, large 16-40, huge > 40.

biome.description: The one place the map shows, from the map type and the judged environments.

features.description: What is drawn that a builder asks for by name: water, roads, stairs, blocking props.

family_coverage.description: Curation: what this collection supplies toward a complete style family (C2 §2).

creation_choice.description: True only when curation approved it as part of a style family offered at creation.

pack_manifest.description: Path to the existing pack.json this card was built from.

hash_manifest.description: Bucket key of a list of sha256 hashes for every file in the collection, carded or not (e.g. symbol bitmaps that are never tagged). The repo commit check blocks all of them when the collection's redistribution is none.

search_summary.description: One line describing what this library is good for, built by code from its cards (what it holds, and the moods and genres it covers most). The answer to 'which pack has feet on gravel' before any file is opened.

files_total.description: All files in the collection, including those without cards.

nearest.description: Closest existing tag the tagger used instead, if any.

provenanceMap.description: Keyed by field path ('describe.moods', 'rig', 'rights', '*' for a default). A block-level key covers every field inside it. Fields with no entry fall back to '*'.

locked.description: True for human edits: no pipeline run may overwrite this field.

input.description: What the writer looked at, e.g. 'sheet sha256:… + measured facts'.
